pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Berlin Variation

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Motzko Attack, Nenarokov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 suggested ...Na5 with no knight on c6; overview misdescribed 10.Qd3. Rewrote overview and plan 1 (accepted). The plan 2 rewrite was rejected (a knight on f5 does not press on e5), so plan 2 keeps its old text in this commit and is resubmitted with batch 2026-11-23-4. British spelling.
